title: Unknown Artist 8-Track Tape 78 Records 90:15 Scotch Brand
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track tape featuring music by an unknown artist, released on the Track Record label. The tape is in a 78 records format and uses Scotch Brand adhesive for its packaging. This vintage music format offers a unique listening experience and allows for the artist's music to be preserved and enjoyed for years to come.
